After getting a stone tablet, head to Kuza and break the seal of one of the weapons. You can do 3 per tablet, either all tablets at once or one tablet at a time.

During the third act of the game, after finishing Fork Tower and re-obtaining the submarine, head to where the Walse tower sank (The pocket of water south east of Phoenix Tower, south west of Carwen) and get to the lowest floor to obtain that one shard you couldn't get before.
After entering the point of no return dungeon "Interdimensional Rift", you'll find Omega roaming around in the "Interdimensiona Rift - Cave" map.
In the final dungeon, the superboss Shinryu will be hidden inside a chest near the screen where you fight the final boss. If you're working for the "all chests" achievements.

achievements.description: Learned 10 kinds of blue magic techniques.
achievements.hint: Some blue magic requires Beastmaster's control and your "learner's" character level to be divisable by specific numbers. The last one with that requirement you will find is "Level 2 Old". These spells are "Level 5 Death", "level 4 Graviga", "Level 2 Old" and " Level 3 Flare". Basically if you hit level 99 without obtaining all these spells (besides level 3 flare), they all become unavailable. Do note that only one character has to learn the blue magic for all characters to get it, the blue mage (job) does not need to have the Learn ability equipped for the blue mage (job) to learn the blue mage spells. One can also use a job that is not blue mage and just equip the Learn ability to learn spells.

The achievement only counts for the character with the most mastered jobs and only the jobs that character maxed, meaning if you have 21/22 jobs in one character and you do the last one on another it wont count, that character has to have all 22/22 jobs maxed.
